worldcombat.skill.falseswipe.summary: An extremely precise shallow cut along a thin seam in front: it only chips HP and always leaves the target with at least 1 HP. Full draws a heavier, slower blow; Light is lighter and quicker.
worldcombat.skill.falseswipe.use.0: Cut a target down to 1 HP for capture
worldcombat.skill.falseswipe.use.1: Keep pressure on a foe that must stay alive
worldcombat.skill.falseswipe.use.2: Whittle a threat without killing it
worldcombat.skill.falseswipe.use.3: Control a target's remaining HP before the finish
worldcombat.skill.falseswipe.description: The shallow cut deals about %1$s damage; if that would be lethal it is capped so the target keeps at least 1 HP. The target's defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
The seam is about %1$s blocks long, %2$s blocks half-wide, and runs from the feet up to about %3$s blocks; every non-friendly body along it is cut once.
worldcombat.skill.falseswipe.option.on: Full draw: power about x1.18 and reach +0.2 blocks, at wind-up +3 and cooldown +6 ticks - heavier but slower.
worldcombat.skill.falseswipe.option.off: Light: power about x0.82, a faster cast and a shorter cooldown - lighter and more nimble.
worldcombat.skill.falseswipe.timing: Cut up to %1$s blocks away; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.falseswipe.growth.0: At level %1$s the cut rises to %2$s power.
On: power about x1.18 and reach +0.2 blocks, at wind-up +3 and cooldown +6 ticks - a deeper cut against thick targets. Off (Light): power about x0.82, a faster cast and a shorter cooldown - keeps the rhythm in ordinary fights. Neither version can knock the target out.
The companion only offers the blade at a threat this close; higher lets it step in further before cutting.
On: a high-HP target scores one tier higher, for chipping without killing; off: ranked as an ordinary melee move and used less on a nearly-downed target.
